why do we oil the bicycle chain to stop rust

what does a fair test mean in science

why do people freeze in an emergency instead of acting

Freezing is not cowardice, it is a search. Your brain reaches for a stored plan that matches what it is seeing, and when it finds nothing it keeps searching while the seconds run. who decides what a sanitation worker gets paid

Mostly a chain of decisions the worker is not in. 🧹 A municipal budget sets the size of the pot, contractors bid low to win the tender, and pay lands where bargaining power is weakest — which is why in many Indian cities this work runs on short contracts rather than permanent posts. The work is essential and the pay rarely reflects that, because usefulness and wages are set by different things.

how many languages are actually spoken in india
